did.description: The target account's DID whose access list is being enumerated.

entries.description: Membership filter: return only these DIDs, and of them only those present in the account's access list. A supplied DID absent from the response's entries is not in the list. Omitted = enumerate the whole list.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Omitted on the first request; echoed verbatim thereafter. Opaque to the requester.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return in this page. The mediator MAY apply a smaller server-side bound.

Response.title: Messaging List Access List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/access-list/list request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/access-list/list/0.1#response.

did.description: The account whose access list was enumerated.

entries.description: The current page of entries from the account's access list.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page. Present only where further entries remain; omitted on the final page.

accessListCount.description: The total number of entries in the account's access list.
